chapters.text: Buying for the woman who changes bags three times a day? A big one for work, a small one for the evening, and somewhere for her cards in between. This Christmas, give her all three, in one box under the tree.
Lift the lid and there they are: the hobo bag, a crossbody and a matching pouch, all in the same soft leather and the same colour. Three pieces, and every one of them goes with the others.
The hobo carries her whole day, work things and all. The crossbody goes on when she wants to go light, a walk, a market, a night out, with both hands on the shopping instead of on her bag.
And the pouch keeps her cards and cash in one place, so it moves from the hobo to the crossbody in a second, and nothing gets left behind in the other bag.

chapters.text: Right now you probably carry one big tote everywhere. Work, errands, dinner, the school gate, the weekend. It's open at the top, it holds a bit of everything, and your cards always end up somewhere near the bottom.
Switch to the 3-Piece Set and you get three matching pieces instead: a big bag, a smaller one and a pouch, all in the same colour, made to go together, so whatever the plan is, one of them fits it.
First difference. The smart compartments and the anti-theft design keep everything secure and in its place. One pull on the zip, and nothing sits loose at the top of an open bag.
Second difference: the crossbody. On a busy Christmas shopping day it goes across you, the hobo stays home, and the pouch holds your cards and cash, ready at the till.
